features.name: The one Lens: point it and it knows the job
features.where: SEE → LENS (tap START)
features.does: Shows a card under the picture for each thing it understands, each with only the keys that do its job; the picture is in true colour in every look.
features.note: The camera opens only on his tap, never by itself.

features.name: The eyes pack (object finder) and the namer pack
features.where: SEE → LENS → the line under the picture (GET THE EYES · 18 MB, ON WI-FI)
features.does: Downloads the on-phone object finder and the namer on his tap, on Wi-Fi, with the size said; after that they load from the phone, offline too.
features.note: Without the eyes the Lens still reads text, codes and the faces he introduced.

features.name: Words: read aloud, translate, copy
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at text (TEXT card)
features.does: Reads the words on the phone; reads them aloud in their own language's voice; a sign in another language is translated by itself (only the words are sent).
features.note: Languages told apart on the phone: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch.

features.name: A date in the words → the Agenda
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a date (A DATE card → ADD TO AGENDA)
say: put this date in my diary
features.does: Puts an all-day entry on that day; the card then says IN YOUR AGENDA.
features.note: Only dates written out ('4 December', '04/12/2026'); 'next Tuesday' is not understood yet.

features.name: A phone number → call
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a number (A PHONE NUMBER card → CALL)
features.does: Opens the phone's dialler with the number; an order, invoice or account number is never offered as a phone number.

features.name: An address → the map
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at an address (AN ADDRESS card → ON THE MAP)
features.does: Opens God's Eye's map at the address, with its street line.
features.note: Needs a UK postcode on the line; finding the place needs a signal.

features.name: A link or an email address
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a link (A LINK / AN EMAIL ADDRESS card)
features.does: OPEN or WRITE; a link that looks wrong (look-alike, unencrypted, a bare number) is OPEN ANYWAY with its warning said first.

features.name: A sum solved and shown worked
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a sum (A SUM · SOLVED card)
features.does: Works a sum or a simple equation line by line, as taught (brackets, powers, ×, ÷, +, −, percentages, 2x + 3 = 11), and says the working.
features.note: One printed line in numbers; word problems and handwriting go to ASK or MARK MY WORK.

features.name: A bill or a letter
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a bill (the words' plate → REMIND ME / FILE; A LETTER card)
features.does: Finds the sender, the amount and the date to pay by; REMIND ME sets a nine o'clock reminder (he confirms the day); FILE keeps it in the library under the sender.

features.name: A whole page scanned flat
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a page (A PAGE card → SCAN IT FLAT), or MORE → SCAN → DOCUMENT
features.does: Straightens the page, cleans it and keeps it as a PDF in the library.

features.name: A shop barcode or a book's ISBN
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a barcode (A PRODUCT / A BOOK card)
features.does: Looks it up on Open Food Facts and its sister open databases (Open Library for books): name, size, Nutri-Score, figures per 100 g, allergens and whose data it is; only the number is sent.
features.note: Needs a signal; offline it says so and looks again later.

features.name: QR codes acted on
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a QR code (A LINK / WI-FI / CONTACT / PLACE CODE card), or MORE → SCAN → CODE
features.does: A link opens (OPEN ANYWAY when it looks wrong), a Wi-Fi code gives COPY PASSWORD, a contact CALL and WRITE, a place ON THE MAP, a text or email code TEXT or WRITE.

features.name: A thing named, with how sure
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at a thing (A MUG card → MEASURE IT / ASK ABOUT IT)
features.does: Names the thing on the phone with how sure it is ('82% sure').
features.note: Needs the eyes pack; 'looks like a…' names need the namer pack.

features.name: A plant or an animal: the species
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at it (A ROBIN card → WHICH SPECIES)
say: what kind of plant is that
features.does: One tap: the picture goes to the free model that sees (plants to Pl@ntNet with his free key) and comes back with the species, the Latin name, how sure, the tell-tale, WIKIPEDIA, SAVE and KEEP.
features.note: Needs a signal; nothing is kept unless he saves it.

features.name: A landmark or a work of art
features.where: SEE → LENS, point at it (A CLOCK TOWER card → WHAT PLACE IS THIS)
features.does: The free model that sees names it, with its encyclopedia summary and a WIKIPEDIA key; ASK AGAIN if it is wrong.
features.note: Needs a signal; the answer lasts only while that thing stays in view.

features.name: Faces: him and the people he introduces
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → PEOPLE (ENROL ME); 'this is Sam' with someone in view
features.does: Knows only him and people he introduced, by the name he gave; a stranger is 'Someone I don't know. I never identify a stranger.' Faces never leave the phone.

features.name: Check it's live, before a face is saved
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → PEOPLE → ENROL ME (or 'this is Sam')
features.does: Asks for a random blink or head turn so a photo held up to the camera cannot be saved as a face.

features.name: SEE: live boxes and counts
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → SEE
features.does: Boxes round 80 everyday things with names, how sure, a scene line and running counts; tap a box to ask, search, read or save.

features.name: READ: text into the library, with the number-plate check
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → READ
features.does: Reads a still or a picked photo on the phone; edit, save, copy or ask; a UK number plate offers CHECK THIS VEHICLE? (the public MOT record, on his tap only).

features.name: MARK MY WORK
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → READ → MARK
features.does: Marks a page of his own answers the way SCHOOL does: marks per question, a total, a band 'as this scheme sees it', and the misses kept as revision cards.
features.note: He corrects the handwriting first; it is never a real exam grade.

features.name: ASK: a question with a picture
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → ASK
features.does: Sends a still and his question to the brain; WHAT'S IN IT? gives the foods in a meal and a rough total; with no model that sees, it describes from what the phone saw.

features.name: NAME: the closest names for anything
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → NAME (MORE NAMES for 32,800 names)
features.does: The five closest of 4,624 everyday names, on the phone; a tap names just that part; people are only ever 'person'.
features.note: MORE NAMES is a download on his tap.

features.name: Search by picture
features.where: SEE → LENS → FREEZE → a box → SEARCH
features.does: Crops the picture and opens Google Lens, Bing, Yandex or TinEye with a link that lasts 24 hours; FORGET NOW takes it down.

features.name: PHOTO TOOLS
features.where: SEE → LENS → FREEZE → PHOTO TOOLS
features.does: Background removed, twice as sharp, or a thing erased, with BEFORE/AFTER, SAVE and SHARE, on free online tools.
features.note: The free tools can be asleep or over their free limit; it says so and asks him to try again in a minute.

features.name: HANDS: gestures drive the Lens
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → HANDS
features.does: Thumbs up saves, open palm freezes, two fingers flip, pointing up reads, a fist stops the camera.

features.name: AIM: labels over what is out there
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → AIM
features.does: Camera, compass and his position on the phone put labels over aircraft, ships, buses, hilltops, towers and the space station, with distance and height.
features.note: Needs a compass; his position stays on the phone.

features.name: MEASURE: sizes from a picture
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → MEASURE, or a thing's card → MEASURE IT
features.does: Width, height and depth from one photo with a likely range, scaled by things of known size; every number is a first estimate.
features.note: Works on a held frame, not drawn over the live picture.

features.name: SOUND: is it distorting?
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → SOUND
features.does: Listens or plays a test tone and gives one plain verdict (clipping, hum, boom, harshness) with the spectrum drawn.

features.name: SHAPES: a room drawn in the air
features.where: SEE → LENS → MORE → SHAPES
features.does: He draws with one finger; it becomes a clean blueprint and a 3-D room in the 3D STUDIO.
features.note: Lengths are first estimates until he says one real length.

features.name: Every state said in his words
features.where: SEE → LENS
features.does: Waking the eyes, looking, reading again, nothing found, no signal, a pack not downloaded: each said plainly.

upward.idea: Menus and pages translated in place, line by line
upward.why: A whole menu or leaflet shown in English over the original, not just a short sign.
upward.builds_on: The sign translated in place and the WHAT IT SAYS plate

upward.idea: Dates and times like 'next Tuesday at 3' understood
upward.why: Event posters and texts become agenda entries at the right time, not only written-out dates.
upward.builds_on: The date card and the agenda's add

upward.idea: Handwritten and multi-line maths, with fractions and graphs
upward.why: Homework help at the level of the best maths camera apps, with the working shown.
upward.builds_on: The worked sums and MARK MY WORK

upward.idea: An on-phone species pack (offered on his tap, on Wi-Fi, with its size)
upward.why: Plants, birds and insects named with no signal, on walks in the country.
upward.builds_on: The offline eyes packs and WHICH SPECIES

upward.idea: Sizes drawn over the live picture
upward.why: Point and see a sofa's width as you move, like a tape measure in the air.

upward.idea: Auto-capture for pages: the edges found live, the shot taken when he holds still
upward.why: Many pages scanned fast into one tidy PDF, like a specialist scanner app.
upward.builds_on: SCAN's document part and the steady-frame check

upward.idea: His own allergy and diet list, kept on the phone, lighting up product cards
upward.why: A red, amber or green line on every packet before he buys it.
upward.builds_on: The product card's allergens and figures per 100 g

upward.idea: Compare two products side by side
upward.why: Pick the healthier or cheaper of two packets in the shop.
upward.builds_on: The product card and the open food databases

upward.idea: The Lens learns which card he picks (on the phone only) and puts it first
upward.why: Fewer taps: the job he wants is the first card.

upward.idea: A hands-free 'tell me what you see' mode that speaks as he walks
upward.why: Useful in poor light, with full hands, or for anyone with weak sight.
upward.builds_on: The cards' words and READ ALOUD

upward.idea: Several moments held at once in a strip, each with its cards
upward.why: Snap a noticeboard, a timetable and a menu, then deal with them later.

upward.idea: Remembered places: a named landmark kept on SAVE and known again
upward.why: His own diary of places seen, and no need to ask twice.
upward.builds_on: WHAT PLACE IS THIS and the nature diary

upward.idea: QR links checked against free public lists of known scam sites
upward.why: A stronger warning on a parking-meter sticker before he pays.
upward.builds_on: The link card's OPEN ANYWAY warnings

upward.idea: Addresses outside the UK, and without a postcode
upward.why: Travel leaflets and foreign letters go to the map too.

sideways.idea: Business card → a contact on his phone
sideways.why: One point and the name, number and email are saved.
sideways.builds_on: The phone, email and address finders and the contact QR card

sideways.idea: Medicine box → its public NHS leaflet, read aloud
sideways.why: The dose and warnings in plain words from the official leaflet (never advice of its own).
sideways.builds_on: READ, the barcode lookup and READ ALOUD

sideways.idea: Appliance rating plate → running cost (a first estimate)
sideways.why: Point at a heater's label and see roughly what an hour costs.
What the light means and whether to stop, from the free model that sees.
sideways.builds_on: ASK with a picture and the car area

sideways.idea: Plant care after the species: watering reminders
sideways.why: Name a plant, then get its public care notes and a reminder in the agenda.
sideways.builds_on: WHICH SPECIES and the date card's agenda add

sideways.why: The washing symbols in plain words.
sideways.builds_on: NAME and the free model that sees

sideways.idea: A bus stop or timetable sign → live departures
sideways.why: Point at the stop's sign and see when the next bus comes, from public transport data.
sideways.builds_on: READ and the transit data already in Ghosty

sideways.idea: Colour of a thing named, for paint and clothes matching
sideways.why: 'That's a dusty blue', with the nearest plain colour name.
sideways.builds_on: The colour-naming already in the Lens

sideways.idea: A slide or a screen → notes
sideways.why: Point at a presentation and the words go straight into DOCS.

sideways.idea: Night sky: stars and planets named
sideways.why: AIM at the sky and see what is up there, from public sky data.

sideways.idea: A book's cover → the reading list, with a free copy if public domain
sideways.why: Point at a book and keep it, or open it from the Internet Archive.
sideways.builds_on: The ISBN lookup and the library

sideways.idea: A receipt read into its lines
sideways.why: Each item and price, ready to file or split.

cross.idea: Receipts and bills from the Lens straight into the month's spending and budgets
cross.why: No typing: the amount, the shop and the day are filed by a point.

cross.idea: Point at the fridge or a cupboard: the pantry filled and recipes suggested, with his allergy list checked
cross.why: Dinner from what he has, safely.

cross.idea: Worked sums and MARK MY WORK feeding revision cards and SCHOOL
cross.why: Every mistake on paper becomes practice.

cross.idea: An event poster becomes an agenda entry with the journey there
cross.why: One point: the date, the place and when to leave.

cross.idea: MEASURE and SHAPES sizes checked against furniture in the 3D studio and the workbench
cross.why: Will it fit? Answered from one photo (a first estimate).

cross.idea: A landmark's card opens its spot on God's Eye's map
cross.why: From 'what is that?' to where it is and what is around it.
